chunks: This is the fire which you denied.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the fire that disbelievers denied?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of *Taqdir* (divine decree) where the punishment itself becomes the proof of the truth previously denied. It underscores the psychological torment of the disbelievers realizing that the very reality they mocked is now their eternal abode, fulfilling the promise of divine justice. This moment serves as a definitive closure to the narrative of denial, emphasizing that their rejection was not merely intellectual but a spiritual blindness to the inevitable.
